 Two held with pistol, grenades during naka checking in Kulgam
 Agencies 
 08 Nov 2026 17:08 IST
 Follow Us
 Kulgam, Nov 08 : Two persons were apprehended after security forces recovered a Chinese pistol, two grenades and ammunition from their possession during a naka checking at Paniwah area of Kulgam district on Sunday, officials said.
 An official told the news agency—Kashmir News Observer (KNO) that a joint team of security personnel was conducting a naka at Paniwah when two persons coming from an orchard area towards Kulgam were intercepted.
 He said a search of the duo led to the recovery of one Chinese pistol, one magazine, two 9 mm rounds and two Chinese grenades from their possession.
 Meanwhile, a case has been registered and further investigation is underway.—(KNO)
